Intelligent Mobile Cabin Hospital

Deployment/Retrieval: 36h / 24h
Mobility: Sea-land-air global amphibious support
Sea-land-air global mobility with 36-hour rapid deployment; all-weather and all-terrain medical support for mass casualty rescue, epidemic prevention, and humanitarian aid.
Get quotationWhatsApp
The Intelligent Mobile Cabin Hospital is designed with lightweight and modular concepts, integrating professional medical hardware with smart information systems. It possesses sea-land-air amphibious mobility for global deployment. The system can be rapidly expanded within 36 hours and retrieved within 24 hours, significantly boosting response efficiency. It handles mass casualty treatment, epidemic control, disaster relief, and international aid, providing all-weather, standardized medical support for complex disaster sites.
  • Overview
  • Technical Specifications
  • Contact us

Features

  • Lightweight modular design with integrated hardware/software. Sea-land-air global mobility for rapid 36-hour deployment and 24-hour retrieval.
  • Smart unit configuration and all-weather high-level medical support. Ideal for mass casualty rescue, epidemic control, and humanitarian aid.
  • Figure 2 Intelligent Mobile Cabin Hospital
